chars.YOUNES: YOUNES: a young man wearing a tailored charcoal grey suit, white shirt, thin black tie, silver wristwatch.
chars.HAMZA: HAMZA: a young man wearing a mustard yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans, white sneakers.
chars.AZIZ: AZIZ: a young man wearing a green and black checked flannel shirt over a white t-shirt, beige chinos, round glasses.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modern glass office tower in Casablanca, Younes sits proudly at a big desk with two monitors, colleagues' empty desks behind, confident relaxed posture.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Younes walks out of a shiny corporate building in Casablanca, holding a leather briefcase, smiling, a nice new car parked by the curb.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Late evening, Younes alone in a dim apartment, hunched over a laptop with intense focus, papers scattered, coffee cup, mysterious mood, laptop screen glow on his face, screen facing away from viewer.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Hamza and Aziz sit at a small table on a Moroccan cafe terrace with mint tea glasses, Hamza scrolling his phone casually, Aziz relaxed, afternoon light, palm trees.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same cafe terrace: Hamza suddenly freezes staring at his phone, mouth open in shock, Aziz leans over his shoulder, eyes wide, mint tea glass tipping over.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a small shared workspace room, Hamza and Aziz hold two phones side by side and compare them, faces stunned and angry, sticky notes and sketches of app screens on the wall behind them (blank, no writing).

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, small cramped room, Hamza and Aziz stand in front of a laptop on a desk, a red downward arrow shape glowing on the wall behind them, both worried, hands on heads.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night on a rooftop in Casablanca, Aziz sits with his head in his hands, Hamza stands beside him staring at the city lights, sad defeated mood, crumpled papers by their feet.
